queries: WITH patient_stats AS (SELECT ID, AVG(CASE WHEN HGB IS NOT NULL AND HCT IS NOT NULL AND HCT <> 0 THEN HGB / HCT END) AS ratio, AVG(PIC) AS avg_pic FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID), overall AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM patient_stats) SELECT AVG(p.avg_pic) AS mean_avg_pic, AVG(p.ratio) AS mean_ratio, AVG(p.ratio - o.avg_ratio) AS mean_excess_ratio FROM patient_stats AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE p.ratio > o.avg_ratio;

WITH patient_stats AS (SELECT ID, AVG(CASE WHEN HGB IS NOT NULL AND HCT IS NOT NULL AND HCT <> 0 THEN HGB END) / AVG(CASE WHEN HGB IS NOT NULL AND HCT IS NOT NULL AND HCT <> 0 THEN HCT END) AS ratio, AVG(PIC) AS avg_pic FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID), overall AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM patient_stats) SELECT AVG(p.avg_pic) AS mean_avg_pic, AVG(p.ratio) AS mean_ratio, AVG(p.ratio - o.avg_ratio) AS mean_excess_ratio FROM patient_stats AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE p.ratio > o.avg_ratio;

WITH patient_ratios AS (SELECT ID, AVG(CASE WHEN HGB IS NOT NULL AND HCT IS NOT NULL AND HCT <> 0 THEN HGB / HCT END) AS ratio, AVG(PIC) AS avg_pic FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID), cross_patient AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM patient_ratios) SELECT AVG(p.avg_pic) AS mean_avg_pic, AVG(p.ratio) AS mean_ratio, AVG(p.ratio - c.avg_ratio) AS mean_excess FROM patient_ratios p CROSS JOIN cross_patient c WHERE p.ratio > c.avg_ratio

assumptions.assumption: A patient's ratio is the average of their individual lab-record HGB/HCT ratios; records with missing values or zero HCT cannot contribute. Their average PIC uses all available PIC values.

alternatives.interpretation: A patient's ratio is their average HGB divided by their average HCT, using lab records where both values are present and HCT is nonzero.
